title: WAFA reports child’s death after earlier shooting in southern Gaza
summary: WAFA reported on October 27 that a six-year-old girl died Tuesday morning from wounds sustained in an earlier shooting in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis. The report does not specify when the shooting occurred.

title: WAFA reports displacement after camp fire in Gaza City
summary: WAFA reported on October 26 that a displacement-camp fire near the Shuja’iyya junction in eastern Gaza City, described as occurring the previous night, displaced more than 800 Palestinians and affected more than 200 families.

title: WAFA reports Deir al-Balah drone strike
summary: WAFA reported that two Palestinians were killed and another was wounded in a drone strike on Deir al-Balah on October 26.
